privileged.apps/projects/service/deals.ts: Deal board: the org's time zone (the organizations table is closed to row-level readers) is read in a privileged transaction of the org the caller passes, one column, no person.
privileged.modules/agent/runtime/tool-card-store.ts: A stored tool card: a person's card action changes one field of an agent's row (whose write the RLS policy leaves to its author), after the caller's read was checked under their own context.
privileged.modules/apps/org-features.ts: The one writer of kernel.org_app_features: a member has no write path on the table, so the row is written privileged after the feature's adminScope is checked.
privileged.modules/approvals/route-world.ts: Approval routing: reads away ranges and preferences of the people in one org, and moves the pending requests linked to an item that changed hands, all pinned to that org.
privileged.modules/users/away.ts: Away days: the one writer of kernel.away_ranges (no member write path), its daily prune, and the next-in-line column a colleague's read needs, all pinned to one org but the prune.
privileged.apps/calendar/away-from-calendar.ts: Away days from a person's own calendar: the daily refresh lists every personal primary calendar and reads each one's stored events in a system transaction of that org.
privileged.modules/approvals/routed-reminders.ts: Routed reminders: the hourly sweep scans pending requests of every org (one bounded, paged read), then reads one org's routes, deciders and people by org id before any request actor exists.
privileged.modules/contacts/companies.ts: A company rename rewrites the company name every linked person carries, and a delete clears the company from deals and pipelines: both run elevated in the caller's transaction (withElevatableRlsFrom + asAdmin).
privileged.modules/contacts/company-unowned.ts: After a company's manager changed or its manager came back (an event, no request context): the previous manager's Home row and the admins' unowned rows, by org id.
privileged.modules/contacts/prospect-retention.ts: The daily review of prospects silent for three years: one Home row per org for whoever can act on it, written across orgs by the job, never by a request.
privileged.tests/helpers/company.ts: A client company for the tests that create a portal account.
privileged.tests/helpers/commercial-identity.ts: The identity a test org's commercial mail states (one settings key).
privileged.tests/helpers/prospect.ts: Records the lawful basis a commercial test mail needs on its recipient's contact.

privileged.modules/mail/send-guard.ts: The send check reads other mailboxes' envelopes on purpose: a reply in a colleague's mailbox still stops a send. Reads only, and it names no text.
privileged.modules/mail/optout-wording.ts: A reply asking to stop arrives in mail sync (no actor): it reads the org's own addresses and the opt-out requests already waiting, then raises one for the mailbox's owner to decide.
privileged.modules/mail/suppressions.ts: The opt-out list is read for whoever sends (a fingerprint lookup, no address kept), and an opt-out recorded by the system (a link, a reply) has no person to act as.
privileged.modules/mail/commercial-footer.ts: A commercial mail's opt-out link: minted on the send path and resolved by the public opt-out page, which has no person and learns the org from the link's row (a fingerprint, no address kept); the org's commercial identity is read for whoever sends.
privileged.modules/mail/commercial-send-record.ts: A commercial send's record, written once the provider accepted it, for whoever sent it (an agent's approved mail or a person's own): the audit row and the notice mark.
privileged.modules/approvals/withdraw-on-events.ts: Waiting drafts to an address that opted out are cancelled, whoever staged them.
